notes.title: 🎥 News Company Simulator – First Trailer Released!
notes.notes:
[p]"Hey everyone, fellow gamers! 👋[/p][p]We’re a small indie team, and today is a very special moment for us – we can finally share the [b]first official trailer[/b] of [b]News Company Simulator[/b] with you! 🎬[/p][p]In the trailer, you’ll catch a glimpse of what it’s like to build and run your very own news company:
📰 Choosing stories and making editorial decisions
📊 Managing your company and making strategic choices
⚡ Competing in a challenging media landscape[/p][p]This means a lot to us, because it’s the first time we’re showing the project we’ve been working on for months. 💙
Your feedback is incredibly valuable – after watching the trailer, let us know what you think and what kind of headlines [i]you[/i] would make![/p][p]👉 Watch the trailer now and tell us: What would be your very first front-page story?[/p][p]Thanks for being here with us,
– The News Company Simulator Team[/p]
